message.content:
Here’s a mix of classic, modern, and cult‑favorite horror films you might enjoy:

| # | Title | Year | Director | Why it’s worth watching |
|---|-------|------|----------|------------------------|
| 1 | **The Shining** | 1980 | Stanley Kubrick | A masterclass in psychological dread and atmospheric tension. |
| 2 | **Hereditary** | 2018 | Ari Aster | A chilling family saga that blends supernatural terror with raw emotional depth. |
| 3 | **Get Out** | 2017 | Jordan Peele | A smart, socially conscious horror that mixes satire with genuine scares. |
| 4 | **A Quiet Place** | 2018 | John Krasinski | Suspense built around silence; a tense, inventive thriller. |
| 5 | **Midsommar** | 2019 | Ari Aster | A daylight horror that turns a pastoral festival into a nightmare. |
| 6 | **The Conjuring** | 2013 | James Wan | A well‑crafted paranormal investigation that balances jump‑scares with dread. |
| 7 | **It Follows** | 2014 | David Robert Mitchell | A unique premise—an invisible curse that follows you—paired with a haunting score. |
| 8 | **The Babadook** | 2014 | Jennifer Kent | Psychological horror that explores grief and motherhood through a sinister entity. |
| 9 | **Suspiria (1977)** | 1977 | Dario Argento | A visually stunning, surrealist horror that remains influential. |
|10 | **The Witch** | 2015 | Robert Eggers | A slow‑burn, period‑accurate tale of paranoia and supernatural dread. |
|11 | **Paranormal Activity** | 2007 | Oren Peli | Low‑budget found‑footage style that still delivers effective tension. |
|12 | **The Ring** | 2002 | Gore Verbinski | A modern retelling of a Japanese horror classic, with a creepy videotape twist. |
|13 | **The Cabin in the Woods** | 2012 | Drew Goddard | A meta‑take on horror tropes that subverts expectations while delivering scares. |
|14 | **The Others** | 2001 | Alejandro Amenábar | Atmospheric suspense with a twist ending that keeps you guessing. |
|15 | **Poltergeist** | 1982 | Tobe Hooper | Classic supernatural horror that set the standard for haunted‑house films. |

Feel free to pick based on your mood—whether you want a psychological thriller, a supernatural scare, or something that plays with genre conventions. Happy watching!
